leadText:
Volume 48 is the 48th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the sixth volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume six of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".
plainText:
Volume 48 is the 48th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the sixth volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume six of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
Team Plasma launches an all-out attack on the Nacrene Museum! What will they steal and who will they kidnap...? Black undergoes grueling training to prepare to fight the Legendary Pokémon Zekrom. And White's new battle skills are put to the test when Bianca needs help protecting an innocent Pokémon. Then, flash back in time to see the first spark of Black's dream to become the Pokémon League Champion...

==Important events==
 
The Shadow Triad attack .
The Gym Leaders, apart from Brycen, are captured by the Shadow Triad.
Team Plasma snatch the Dark Stone.
N awakens .
chooses as its hero.
Black meets Drayden.
meets again and receives her Pokédex.
Black begins his battle with Brycen.
